title: Time to compute one 60-second artillery trajectory: by hand, on the Bush differential analyzer, and on ENIAC
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale, seconds. A skilled person with a desk calculator took about 20 hours (72,000 seconds); the Bush differential analyzer about 15 minutes (900 seconds); ENIAC about 30 seconds. Data: William T. Moye, ENIAC: The Army-Sponsored Revolution (Army Research Laboratory, 1996).
heading: ONE 60-SECOND TRAJECTORY · SECONDS, LOG SCALE
